sources.name: Himalayas jobs API
sources.coverage: Remote roles only; disabled in public GitHub data feed by default. Enable only for direct display on the owned site/backend with visible attribution and expiry handling.
sources.method: Set ENABLE_HIMALAYAS_API=1 only after owned-site/backend integration; use applicationLink unchanged, credit Himalayas, remove expired jobs, and never redistribute listings to other aggregators.

sources.name: Karir.com
sources.coverage: Disabled: terms prohibit automated data collection without permission.

sources.name: Indeed
sources.coverage: Disabled: current terms require express written permission for automated scraping/extraction; crawl permission in robots.txt is not blanket republication permission.

sources.name: LinkedIn
sources.coverage: Disabled by default; authorized API/partner access only.

sources.name: Glints
sources.coverage: Disabled: current terms restrict screen scraping without written consent; robots.txt disallows configured explore search URL.

sources.name: Kalibrr
sources.coverage: Enabled: ordinary public HTML; robots.txt checked each run; HTTP blocks and parser mismatches logged.

sources.name: Dealls
sources.coverage: Enabled: public listing HTML only; robots.txt checked each run; no private endpoints.

sources.name: KitaLulus
sources.coverage: Disabled by default until terms and access are reviewed.

sources.name: Instagram/Facebook/TikTok
sources.coverage: Only official platform APIs and authorized accounts/pages

sources.coverage: Disabled pending written permission because site terms restrict copying/reproducing/distributing content.

sources.name: Tech in Asia Jobs
sources.coverage: Enabled for public pages allowed by robots.txt; source links and job metadata only.

sources.name: Maganghub
sources.coverage: Enabled; robots.txt must be readable and permit the configured public URL or source is skipped.

notes.policy: The enabled adapters check robots.txt before fetching. 403/429 and zero-record parser results are logged without permanently disabling a source.
